categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: No files in src/util or shared utility libraries are modified; all changes are confined to src/wallet.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and directly modifies wallet database management and migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/db.cpp.
categories.rationale: This fixes serious wallet data loss and corruption risks in the legacy-to-descriptor migration path. Previously, MigrateToSQLite deleted original BerkeleyDB databases before verifying that SQLite creation succeeded, and mid-process errors or stale journals could leave users with corrupted or missing wallet files requiring manual recovery (noted by reviewer ryanofsky: 'master... deletes the original database before writing the new one and asserts if anything fails after that').
